summary: First testing pass on SIWES Supervisor Allocation System. Backend pytest suite: 22/22 tests passed covering auth (all 4 roles + register + logout + invalid), RBAC (student 403), companies (mine/create/approve), logbooks (full flow with notification), allocations (auto/manual/my-supervisor/my-students), visits+GPS (verify at correct coords => verified, at far coords => failed), dashboards (per-role keys), reports. Frontend: landing page renders with hero-get-started + Login + theme-toggle; theme toggle persists via localStorage across reload. Login demo buttons prefill correctly for all 4 roles and redirect to /app dashboard. Student flow works end-to-end (create logbook entry -> pending badge visible, My Supervisor shows Dr. Abubakar Supervisor with visit history including a verified and a failed visit). Supervisor flow shows Yusuf Student card with approved nHub Foundation company. Coordinator flow shows stats, allocations table with auto-allocate button, reports table with download-csv button. Admin flow loads with equivalent sidebar (Analytics instead of Reports). Notifications page navigable.

issues: Welcome banner truncated as 'Welcome, Dr..' — the greeting appears to slice the name too aggressively. Cosmetic only.

Admin has 'Analytics' link but no 'Reports' link, while coordinator has 'Reports'. Request said 'coordinator-equivalent menu items' — Admin missing Reports/Analytics parity item. Minor consistency issue.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Fix Coordinator dashboard greeting truncation ('Welcome, Dr..').
(Optional) Consider adding a Reports link to the Admin sidebar for parity with Coordinator, since backend allows admin to access /api/reports/summary.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~790 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, companies, logbooks, visits, allocations, reports) for maintainability.

CORS configured with allow_origin_regex='.*' + allow_credentials=True; browsers ignore Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* with credentials, but FastAPI middleware echoes the request origin when using regex, so this works — still, prefer an explicit allowlist for production hardening.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — test_credentials.md-style policy mentions 5-attempt lockout, not implemented.
JWT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env — acceptable for dev/preview but should be rotated for production.
Cookies use SameSite=None + Secure (correct for cross-site preview). Verified auth works end-to-end from the preview frontend.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create one TEST_-prefixed registered user per pytest run (email like TEST_<uuid>@siwes.edu). Logbook entries and visits (TEST_ note) are also created against the seeded student. No cleanup performed but data is prefixed for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 22 tests covering all major flows. Run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Demo seed is idempotent; new pytest runs will accumulate TEST_ prefixed logbook entries and visits. GPS verification tested via backend POST directly (browser geolocation is not available in Playwright).
